title: Park and leave
hints: You need to answer two lookups quickly: who is in a spot, and where is a plate. That suggests two dicts.
Keep `spots: dict[str, str | None]` (spot id to the plate in it, or None when empty) and `parked: dict[str, str]` (plate to spot id). Update both on every park and leave.
Validate before mutating: `park` checks `spot_id in spots`, `spots[spot_id] is None`, and `plate not in parked`, and only then writes. `leave` is `parked.pop(plate, None)` plus clearing the spot.
`free_spots` is `sorted(s for s, plate in spots.items() if plate is None)`.
